FN-YDRCN2-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 117
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Senator Jabo Waggoner
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 05/02/2023
Senate Bill 117 as passed the Senate provides for the donation and delivery of up to 4.5 liters of
liquor to a licensed nonprofit special event and requires such donation to be taxed in accordance
with state and federal laws, rules, and regulations. This bill will otherwise not directly affect
state or local funding.

FN-YDRCN2-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 117
Committee: Economic Development and Sponsor: Senator Jabo Waggoner
Tourism
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 04/19/2023
Senate Bill 117 as reported by the Committee on Economic Development and Tourism would
provide for the donation and delivery of up to 4.5 liters of liquor to a licensed nonprofit special
event and requires such donation to be taxed in accordance with state and federal laws, rules,
and regulations. This bill would otherwise not directly affect state or local funding.
